# Data Layer

> Generated from `src/services/` and `src/hooks/`. Run `/sync-agent-docs` to refresh.
> Rule: components never call Supabase directly — always go through `src/services/` → `src/hooks/`.

## audit

**Service:** `src/services/audit.service.ts`

Wraps all `audits` table operations:
- `listAudits(projectId)` — SELECT audits for a project, ordered by score desc, filtered to `visible_in_app = true`
- `createAudit(params)` — INSERT a new audit row (status `'pending'` by default)
- `deleteAudit(audit)` — DELETE audit row + cleans up unreferenced storage paths
- `updateAuditReport(auditId, ai_report)` — UPDATE `ai_report` JSON on an audit
- `updateAuditReauditExplanation(auditId, reaudit_explanation)` — SET `reaudit_explanation` once
- `updateAuditFeedback(auditId, params)` — UPDATE `feedback_rating` and `feedback_comment`
- `transformAudit(dbRow)` — normalises raw DB row to the typed `Audit` interface

**Hook:** `src/hooks/use-audits.ts`

- `useAudits(projectId)` — query; polls every 5 s while any audit has `pending | processing` status (stops after 10 min)
- `useCreateAudit(projectId)` — mutation; invalidates `audits` query key on success
- `useDeleteAudit(projectId)` — mutation; invalidates `audits` query key on success
- `useUpdateAuditFeedback(projectId)` — mutation; invalidates `audits` and `analytics` query keys
- `useAuditIssueFeedback(auditId)` — query; reads from `audit_issue_feedback` table, 30 s stale time
- `useUpsertAuditIssueFeedback()` — mutation; upserts or deletes a per-issue feedback row

## audit-issue-feedback

**Service:** `src/services/audit-issue-feedback.service.ts`

Wraps `audit_issue_feedback` table:
- `listAuditIssueFeedback(auditId)` — SELECT all feedback rows for an audit ordered by engine + index
- `upsertAuditIssueFeedback(params)` — UPSERT on `(audit_id, engine_id, issue_index)`
- `deleteAuditIssueFeedback(auditId, engineId, issueIndex)` — DELETE a single feedback row

*(Consumed by `use-audits.ts` — no standalone hook file)*

## project

**Service:** `src/services/project.service.ts`

Wraps `projects` and `project_personas` tables:
- `listProjects()` — SELECT all projects ordered by `created_at` desc
- `getProject(id)` — SELECT single project by ID
- `createProject(params)` — INSERT project row + bulk INSERT `project_personas`; optionally uploads context files
- `updateProject(projectId, params)` — UPDATE project fields; DELETE + re-INSERT all personas
- `deleteProject(project)` — DELETE project + cascade audits; removes storage paths for screenshots

**Hooks:** `src/hooks/use-projects.ts` and `src/hooks/use-project.ts`

- `useProjects()` — query; returns list of all user's projects; enabled when user is authenticated
- `useExistingProducts()` — derived hook; returns unique product names for the section-project flow
- `useCreateProject()` — mutation; invalidates `projects` query key on success
- `useDeleteProject()` — mutation; invalidates `projects` query key on success
- `useProject(projectId)` — query; fetches single project by ID
- `useUpdateProject(projectId)` — mutation; invalidates `project`, `projects`, and `personas` query keys on success

## context-documents

**Service:** `src/services/context-documents.service.ts`

Wraps `project_context_documents` table + `context-documents` storage bucket:
- `addContextDocument(projectId, userId, file, extractedText)` — upload file to storage, INSERT DB row, fire-and-forget summary generation
- `addContextDocumentText(projectId, content, originalFilename)` — INSERT text-only document (no file upload)
- `addContextDocumentFromIntegration(projectId, source, content, filename, externalId?)` — INSERT document sourced from Drive/Notion
- `listContextDocuments(projectId)` — SELECT all documents for a project
- `deleteContextDocument(doc)` — DELETE DB row + remove storage file
- `deleteAllContextDocuments(projectId)` — bulk delete all documents for a project
- `resolveAdditionalContext(projectId)` — concatenate all document content, truncated to 4000 chars

**Hook:** `src/hooks/use-context-documents.ts`

- `useContextDocuments(projectId)` — query; polls every 3 s while any document is missing its `summary` (async AI generation)
- `useAdditionalContext(projectId)` — query; returns resolved concatenated context string
- `useAddContextDocument(projectId)` — mutation; invalidates `contextDocuments` query key on success
- `useDeleteContextDocument(projectId)` — mutation; invalidates `contextDocuments` query key on success

## integration

**Service:** `src/services/integration.service.ts`

Orchestrates OAuth integrations (Google Drive, Notion, Figma) via Edge Functions:
- `checkIntegrationStatus()` — calls `integration-status` Edge Function; returns `{drive, notion, figma, accounts?}`
- `initiateOAuth(provider, options?)` — calls appropriate `*-auth` Edge Function, redirects browser to OAuth URL
- `getDrivePickerToken()` — calls `google-drive-auth?picker_token=1` to get a decrypted access token for the Drive Picker
- `fetchDriveDocuments(fileIds[])` — calls `google-drive-fetch` to extract file text
- `fetchNotionPages()` — calls `notion-fetch?list_pages=1` to list accessible pages
- `fetchNotionDocuments(pageIds[])` — calls `notion-fetch` to extract page content
- `extractProjectContext(documents[])` — calls `extract-project-context` Edge Function to parse context from docs
- `saveIntegrationDocumentsToProject(projectId, source, docs[])` — bulk calls `addContextDocumentFromIntegration`
- `parseDriveUrl(url)` / `parseNotionUrl(url)` — client-side URL parsers; return file/page IDs

**Hook:** `src/hooks/use-integrations.ts`

- `useIntegrationStatus()` — query; enabled when user is authenticated
- `useInitiateOAuth()` — mutation; shows toast on error
- `useFetchIntegrationDocuments()` — mutation; fetches Drive + Notion docs in parallel
- `useExtractProjectContext()` — mutation; calls `extractProjectContext` service
- `useParseIntegrationUrls()` — returns the two URL-parsing helpers (not a React query, just a convenience wrapper)
- `useSaveIntegrationDocumentsToProject(projectId)` — mutation; invalidates `contextDocuments` query key on success

## storage

**Service:** `src/services/storage.service.ts`

Wraps the `screenshots` storage bucket:
- `uploadScreenshot(filePath, file)` — upload a file; throws `'STORAGE_LIMIT'` or `'PERMISSION_DENIED'` on known errors
- `createScreenshotSignedUrl(filePath, expiresIn?)` — generate a single signed URL (returns as-is if already a full URL)
- `createScreenshotSignedUrls(paths[], expiresIn?)` — bulk signed URL generation (falls back to `/placeholder.svg` on error)
- `removeScreenshotPaths(paths[])` — delete files from bucket (skips full URLs)

**Hook:** `src/hooks/use-project-signed-urls.ts`

- `useProjectSignedUrls(audits)` — manages a 24 h signed URL cache for all audit thumbnails; auto-refreshes on tab focus, on audit list change, and on a 15 min background interval. Returns `getSignedUrl(filePath)`.

## analyze-screenshot

**Service:** *(no dedicated service file — calls Edge Function directly)*

**Hook:** `src/hooks/use-analyze-screenshot.ts`

- `useAnalyzeScreenshot(project, t)` — encapsulates the `POST /analyze-ui` call with a configurable timeout (90 s standard, 150 s when synth personas requested); handles all HTTP error codes and maps them to typed error keys; returns `{ analyzeScreenshot, analyzing, setAnalyzing }`

## daily-limit

**Service:** *(no dedicated service file — queries Supabase directly)*

**Hook:** `src/hooks/use-project-daily-limit.ts`

- `useProjectDailyLimit(user)` — returns `checkDailyLimit()` callback; queries `audits` count for today (Europe/Rome midnight) and checks `has_role(user_id, 'admin')`; admins bypass the limit. Returns `{ limitReached, isAdminBypass }`.
